purpose: Train a new LiDAR-only student on constrained racing-line expert labels from 480 small maps.
method: Fresh CNN behavioral cloning, reflection augmentation and three recovery-oracle DAgger rounds.

base.storage_note: Only current scans stored. Four consecutive scans reconstructed within episode, in chronological order.

final_protocol.completion: Net forward centerline progress of three full laps without reset; collision takes precedence. Early legacy finish zone ignored.

limitations: No real vehicle test of model 6.
Vehicle response randomization is assumed, not independently measured ground-speed dynamics.
Speed cap 6 m/s does not mean constant 6 m/s.
Synthetic held-out maps do not establish collision-free operation on arbitrary real tracks.
Lap times average only completed episodes; always read them together with completion counts.
